what: `pgrep -f "rethru[n].sh" | xargs kill` at the head of an `ix shell .. bash -c '..'` killed that shell itself, twice: the bracket keeps the pattern from matching its own text, but the same command line named `rethrun.sh` in plain further on. Everything after it did not run and printed nothing (mem2-2 again).
cost: two commands that did nothing, five minutes
cause: pattern matching on full command lines
workaround: kill by the pid in the daemon's `serve.lock`
